examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣最好，不冷也不熱。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì zuì hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.english: The weather is the best in autumn, not too cold and not too hot.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣最好，不冷也不熱。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì zuì hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.english: The weather is the best in autumn, not too cold and not too hot.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

items.wordHook: 秋(autumn) + 天(sky) → the autumn sky: 秋天(autumn; fall).

examples.chinese: 你不要忘了告訴他明天有考試。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le gàosu tā míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
examples.english: Don't forget to tell him that there is an exam tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我忘了倒垃圾，所以家裡很臭。客人來的時候，我們要倒茶請他們喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dào lājī, suǒyǐ jiālǐ hěn chòu. Kèrén lái de shíhòu, wǒmen yào dào chá qǐng tāmen hē.
examples.english: I forgot to take out the garbage, so the house smells bad. When guests come, we should pour tea and invite them to drink.

examples.chinese: 我忘了帶課本，上課的時候只好跟同學一起看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dài kèběn, shàngkè de shíhou zhǐhǎo gēn tóngxué yīqǐ kàn.
examples.english: I forgot to bring my textbook, so during class I had no choice but to share with a classmate.

examples.chinese: 把考試的日期記在手機裡，這樣做就不會忘了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ kǎoshì de rìqī jì zài shǒujī lǐ, zhèyàng zuò jiù bù huì wàng le.
examples.english: Record the exam date in your phone; doing it this way, you won't forget.

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎn jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—really silly!

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo shí, bié wàngle wèi tāmen gǔzhǎng, gěi tāmen gǔlì.
examples.english: When others perform well, don't forget to applaud for them and give them encouragement.

examples.chinese: 那道菜一點兒都不鹹，我猜或許是忘了放鹽巴。
examples.pinyin: Nà dào cài yìdiǎnr dōu bù xián, wǒ cāi huòxǔ shì wàngle fàng yánbā.
examples.english: That dish isn't salty at all; I guess maybe they forgot to add salt.

examples.chinese: 我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xué de wǔdǎo hěn fùzá, cháng wàng le shénme shíhou qiánjìn huò hòutuì.
examples.english: The dance I'm newly learning is very complicated; I often forget when to move forward or backward.

items.wordHook: 忘(forget) + 了(done) → the forgetting is done: 忘了(forgot).

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

examples.chinese: 這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huānyíng, bèi rènwéi shì jīnnián de zuìjiā gēqǔ.
examples.english: This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
examples.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 走路的時候看手機是很危險的。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù de shíhou kàn shǒujī shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
examples.english: Looking at your phone while walking is very dangerous.

examples.chinese: 這條公路很危險，一下大雨，山上的石頭就會掉下來。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn wēixiǎn, yī xià dà yǔ, shān shàng de shítou jiù huì diào xiàlái.
examples.english: This road is very dangerous; whenever it rains heavily, rocks from the mountain will fall down.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
examples.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

examples.chinese: 爬山時如果碰到大雨就應避免繼續前進，以免發生危險。
examples.pinyin: Páshān shí rúguǒ pèngdào dàyǔ jiù yīng bìmiǎn jìxù qiánjìn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: When mountain climbing, if you encounter heavy rain, you should avoid continuing to advance, so as to prevent danger from occurring.

examples.chinese: 碰到危險時，人的心跳總跳得很快。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào wēixiǎn shí, rén de xīntiào zǒng tiào de hěn kuài.
examples.english: When encountering danger, a person's heartbeat always beats very fast.

examples.chinese: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén jiēdào rènwu shí, bùguǎn duōme wēixiǎn dōu děi nǔlì wánchéng.
examples.english: When soldiers receive a mission, no matter how dangerous it is, they must strive to complete it.

examples.chinese: 開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí qiānwàn bié bǎ tóu tàn chū chēchuāng wài, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: When driving, by all means don't stick your head out of the car window, to avoid danger.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上大概六點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dàgài liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at about six o'clock every morning.

examples.chinese: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng dàjiā dōu huàzhuāng cānjiā, yàoshi nǐ pèngjiàn wǒ dàgài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shéi.
examples.english: Everyone is attending this event in disguise; if you run into me, you probably won't recognize who I am.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的月亮又大又圓，你看到了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang de yuèliang yòu dà yòu yuán, nǐ kàn dào le ma?
examples.english: Last night's moon was both big and round—did you see it?

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

items.wordHook: Inside the outer 囗(box) perimeter, an official 員(employee) holds a round silver coin to show a 圓(circle).

examples.chinese: 這件衣服太大了，請你幫我改小一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài dà le, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ gǎi xiǎo yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: This piece of clothing is too big; please help me alter it to be a little smaller.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: 我把這篇作文修改好了，明天就可以交給老師了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè piān zuòwén xiūgǎi hǎo le, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ jiāo gěi lǎoshī le.
examples.english: I have revised this essay, so I can hand it to the teacher tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 臺北當地的夜市有很多好吃的宵夜，改天我帶你去嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi dāngdì de yèshì yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de xiāoyè, gǎitiān wǒ dài nǐ qù chángchang.
examples.english: The local night markets in Taipei have many delicious late-night snacks; another day I'll take you to try them.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén de xiǎngfǎ huì suízhe shēnfèn, juésè de bùtóng ér gǎibiàn.
examples.english: A person's way of thinking will change along with differences in identity and role.

examples.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
examples.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xuéxiào de yùsuàn zhǐ gòu xiūlǐ sùshè de wèishēng shèbèi, qítā xūyào gǎishàn de zhǐ néng děng dào míngnián le.
examples.english: This year the school's budget is only enough to repair the dormitory's sanitary facilities; other things that need improvement can only wait until next year.

examples.chinese: 現在去看第一場表演時間快來不及了，要不我們改看下一場吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài qù kàn dì yī chǎng biǎoyǎn shíjiān kuài láibují le, yàobù wǒmen gǎi kàn xià yì chǎng ba.
examples.english: It's almost too late to go see the first performance now; otherwise, let's watch the next one instead.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiguó yǔyán shí zuìhǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuānyè de lǎoshī, hǎo gǎizhèng zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to find a professional teacher so as to correct your own mistakes.

examples.chinese: 他正在修改明天要交出去的計畫，你別去打擾他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiūgǎi míngtiān yào jiāo chūqù de jìhuà, nǐ bié qù dǎrǎo tā.
examples.english: He is revising the plan that is due tomorrow; don't go disturb him.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shīmián le, lián chī le sān tiān de yào yě méi gǎishàn.
examples.english: She has had insomnia recently; she took medicine for three days in a row and still didn't improve.

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 公寓的電梯修復中，請大家改走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyù de diàntī xiūfù zhōng, qǐng dàjiā gǎi zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: The apartment elevator is under repair; please everyone take the stairs instead.

items.wordHook: A 己(self) gets a 攵(rap) on the knuckles to alter its ways → 改(alter).

examples.chinese: 我喜歡夏天到鄉下去住幾天，那裡比都市涼快多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiàtiān dào xiāngxia qù zhù jǐ tiān, nàlǐ bǐ dūshì liángkuai duō le.
examples.english: I like to go to the countryside to stay for a few days in summer; it is much more pleasantly cool there than in the city.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngcūn shēnghuó suīrán bùrú dūshì nàyàng fāngbiàn, dàn fēngjǐng měi duō le.
examples.english: Although countryside life is not as convenient as the city, the scenery is much more beautiful.

examples.chinese: 在熱鬧的都市裡，常見一些人在街頭表演。
examples.pinyin: Zài rènao de dūshì lǐ, cháng jiàn yīxiē rén zài jiētóu biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: In bustling cities, you often see some people performing in the street.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 他來臺灣主要是想了解當地風俗，此外也想學習一點兒華語。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái Táiwān zhǔyào shì xiǎng liǎojiě dāngdì fēngsú, cǐwài yě xiǎng xuéxí yīdiǎnr Huáyǔ.
examples.english: He came to Taiwan mainly to understand local customs; in addition, he also wants to learn a little Chinese.

examples.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 銀做的東西雖然漂亮，不過不好保養。
examples.pinyin: Yín zuò de dōngxi suīrán piàoliang, bùguò bù hǎo bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: Although things made of silver are beautiful, they are not easy to maintain.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 你在銀行存的錢越多，得到的利息也越多。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài yínháng cún de qián yuè duō, dédào de lìxī yě yuè duō.
examples.english: The more money you deposit in the bank, the more interest you get.

examples.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuésheng xiǎng zài Táiwān de yínháng kāihù, děi xiān zhǔnbèi zàixué zhèngmíng.
examples.english: Students at the Mandarin Training Center who want to open an account at a bank in Taiwan must first prepare a certificate of enrollment.

examples.chinese: 我剛來臺灣，不知道怎麼在銀行開戶存錢，請教我怎麼申請。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān, bù zhīdào zěnme zài yínháng kāihù cúnqián, qǐng jiào wǒ zěnme shēnqǐng.
examples.english: I just came to Taiwan and don't know how to open an account and deposit money at a bank; please teach me how to apply.

examples.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
examples.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
examples.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎogé, kàn nǐ bàn shénme shì, jiù yòng shénme biǎogé.
examples.english: There are many kinds of forms in the bank; depending on what you're doing, you use the corresponding form.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 我覺得把錢存在銀行比放在家裡安全多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián cún zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán duō le.
examples.english: I think saving money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

examples.chinese: 我出了捷運站，就看到那家銀行了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū le jiéyùn zhàn, jiù kàndào nà jiā yínháng le.
examples.english: As soon as I exited the MRT station, I saw that bank.

examples.chinese: 哥哥畢業了，下個月要去銀行工作。
examples.pinyin: Gēge bìyè le, xià ge yuè yào qù yínháng gōngzuò.
examples.english: My older brother has graduated; next month he will go to work at a bank.

items.wordHook: a 金(gold) miner pries a 艮(blunt) rock apart → 銀(silver).

examples.chinese: 演唱會開演前，工作人員請大家不要拿手機錄現場的情況。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì kāiyǎn qián, gōngzuò rényuán qǐng dàjiā bùyào ná shǒujī lù xiànchǎng de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Before the concert begins, the staff ask everyone not to use their phones to record the scene.

examples.chinese: 曾經失去一切的人，更懂得愛惜現在擁有的一切。
examples.pinyin: Céngjīng shīqù yíqiè de rén, gèng dǒngde àixī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yíqiè.
examples.english: People who have once lost everything understand even more how to cherish everything they have now.

examples.chinese: 跑步比賽的起點跟終點之間都有人協助，避免參加比賽的人發生狀況。
examples.pinyin: Pǎobù bǐsài de qǐdiǎn gēn zhōngdiǎn zhījiān dōu yǒu rén xiézhù, bìmiǎn cānjiā bǐsài de rén fāshēng zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: Between the starting point and the finishing line of the running race, there are people assisting to prevent situations from happening to the participants.

items.wordHook: A 禾(grain) field feeds one 子(child) for a whole season, so 季 means a quarter-year.
When the 一(one) line lands on 止(stop), everything halts right now → 正(right now).
The 叔(uncle) keeps an 目(eye) on everything → 督(supervise).
